Rentomojo Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates

RENTOMOJO LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Board Meeting to be held on 05-Oct-2026 to inter-alia consider and approve the Unaudited Financial results of the Company for the Quarterly ended June 2027 . |SUBJECT: Board Meeting Intimation
